///WEB REPORT/// AT 10:00, THERE WAS A MALFUNCTION WITH THE ENGINE. THE CAPTAIN AND CREW PROCEEDED TO FIX THE PROBLEM. AT 10:34, THE CAPTAIN INSTRUCTED THE CREW TO CLEAN TWO SEALED (TOPS WERE SEALED BUT SPOUTS WERE OPEN) 5 GALLON BUCKETS OF CHEVERON RYKON OIL. IN DOING SO, THE CREW MEMBERS REMOVED THE LID SEALS AND EMPTIED REMAINING CONTENTS OF BUCKETS (APPROX 3/4 CUP) ONTO DECK TO BE WASHED AWAY BY SEA WATER. BUCKETS WERE CLEANED WITH SOAP AND RINSED IN SAME MANNER. DID NOT TALK TO ANY OF THE CREW OR THE CAPTAIN ABOUT THE DUMPING OF THE OIL. WAS UNABLE TO TAKE VIDEO OR PHOTOGRAPHS OF THE INCIDENT HAPPENING.

Report Description
[WEB REPORT] ON DECEMBER 27, 2012 AT APPROXIMATELY 10:00AM EST, A TRACTOR-TRAILER OPERATED BY THE SUSPECTED RESPONSIBLE PARTY WAS TRAVELING ON I-80, WHEN THE UNIT JACKKNIFED DUE TO WINTER CONDITIONS. THE DRIVER OF THE UNIT LOST CONTROL, AND THE TRACTOR-TRAILER ENDED UP IN THE CENTER MEDIAN OF THE ROADWAY. AS A RESULT OF THE ACCIDENT, BOTH SADDLE FUEL TANKS WERE PUNCTURED AND RELEASED APPROXIMATELY 350 GALLONS OF DIESEL FUEL TO THE ASPHALT SURFACE OF THE ROADWAY AND THE SOIL MEDIAN. FUEL FURTHER MIGRATED FROM THE ROADWAY IN AN ADJACENT STORM DRAIN THAT ULTIMATELY FEEDS INTO THE DELAWARE RIVER.

properties.summary: Incident Type: FIXED - NRC Report ID: 986306 - Medium Affected: AIR - Suspected Responsible Party: 5N PLUS INC.
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 986306
Incident Time: 2011-08-17 05:30:00
Nearest City: Fairfield, CT
Incident Type: FIXED
Material: CHLORINE
Medium Affected: AIR
Suspected Responsible Party: 5N PLUS INC.
Skytruth Analysis
THE FACILITY PRODUCES GALLIUM TRICHLORIDE BY REACTING GALLIUM WITH CHLORINE IN SEVERAL REACTORS. DURING ONE OF THE REACTIONS, SOMEHOW THE GALLIUM TRICHLORIDE PRODUCT MIXED WITH WATER WHICH IS USED IN A SEPARATE PART OF THE REACTOR WITHIN PROTECTIVE BUBBLERS. THE FACILTIY DOES NOT UNDERSTAND HOW THIS SITUATION OCCURRED. THE CHLORINE DETECTORS WITHIN THE REACTOR ROOM WENT OFF AND SHUT DOWN THE SYSTEM. THE RESULTANT VAPORS FROM THE GALLIUM TRICHLORIDE AND THE WATER (GALLIUM OXYCHLORIDE MOST LIKELY) WERE RELEASED TO THE SCRUBBER SYSTEM AND THROUGH THE STACK. A WHITE CLOUD WAS OBSERVED BY ONLOOKERS AND REPORTED TO THE EMERGENCY RESPONDER (FIRE DEPARTMENT - 911). THE CLOUD THAT WAS OBSERVED WAS NOT A CHLORINE CLOUD.

Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 420 gallons
ON JUNE 10, 2011, THE BUREAU OF LAND MANAGEMENT (BLM) CONTACTED REPORTING PARTY TO INFORM [THEM] THAT THE EPA HAD IDENTIFIED IMPACTED SOIL AT THE EPSY 1-22 LOCATION DURING AN INSPECTION. REPORTING PARTY BELIEVES THE RELEASE IS THE RESULT OF A STUFFING BOX LEAK THAT OCCURRED OVER THE WINTER, AND THAT RECENT MELTING SNOW TRANSPORTED THE PRODUCT OFF THE WELL PAD. THE EXACT VOLUME OF MATERIALS RELEASED IS UNKNOWN AT THIS TIME, HOWEVER REPORTING PARTY SUSPECTS AROUND 10 BARRELS. THE SITE IS LOCATED APPROXIMATELY ½ MILE EAST, UPGRADIENT OF SEPARATION CREEK. THE BLM INSPECTORS DID NOT BELIEVE THAT THE RELEASE HAD REACHED THE CREEK, HOWEVER, THE AREA IS HEAVILY WOODED AND IMPACTS TO THE CREEK MAY HAVE NOT BEEN READILY VISIBLE. THE WELL HAS BEEN SHUT IN AND A BERM IS BEING CONSTRUCTED TO PREVENT FURTHER MIGRATION OF THE RELEASED MATERIAL. REPORTING PARTY IS DEVELOPING PLANS FOR ADDITIONAL RESPONSE ACTIVITIES AT THIS TIME.

ACCORDING TO THE CALLER (2) OF THE INJURED PARTIES WERE EMPLOYEES AT THE FACILITY, AND (1) WAS A DRIVER FOR A TRUCKING COMPANY WHO WAS AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE INVOLVEMENT OF THE TRUCK AT THE LOCATION WAS NO SPECIFIED BY THE CALLER.

THE WHITE/SHIMMERY PORTIONS THROUGHOUT THE SLICKS INDICATED RELATIVELY THICKER OIL. WINDS NEAR THE TIME OF THE IMAGE WERE FROM THE ESE AT 10-15 KT WHICH ALIGNED WELL WITH THE SLICK'S ORIENTATION.
